# @ndigo/redis

Node-only Redis connections, namespaced shared cache adapters, WebSocket pub/sub fan-out, distributed-lock/job drivers, and the shared-store rate limiter for Ndigo

Version-matched export index for the installed package. Read `README.md`
for usage; the workspace guide index ships with `@ndigo/cli` as
`assets/agent/docs-index.md`.

## Subpaths

- `@ndigo/redis/cache`
- `@ndigo/redis/pubsub`
- `@ndigo/redis/jobs`
- `@ndigo/redis/locks`
- `@ndigo/redis/rate-limit`

## Capabilities

- `shared-cache` — Share the cache across processes: a Redis-backed CacheManager replaces the per-process memory default. Packages: `@ndigo/redis`. Guide: `persistence-and-shared-stores`.

## Public exports

- `RedisConnection` — Owns a URL-created client or borrows an already-ready client. Construction never connects. Owned connections fail fast without automatic reconnect or offline q…
- `RedisClient` *(type)* — Standalone node-redis client with default string replies (no keyPrefix).
- `RedisConnectionOptions` *(type)* — Explicit connection configuration; injected ready clients are always borrowed.
